conventions.rig: Generic: each figure on its own 65-bone skeleton, its clips its own (no Humanoid retarget). The host finds Head, Hips, RightShoulder and RightHand by name.
conventions.detail: as the bundle has it: one mesh level, no decimation, no texture resize (compression goes through Sky)
conventions.clips: named after the shared controller's states (FigureBuild.CellOverrides swaps them in by name); `props` lists the props an action shows
conventions.props: prop_<name>: one mesh skinned rigidly to its socket bone; shown in the states listed (always: every state)
